h: Governor Umo Eno stands as father, gifts car and ₦5m to bride raised in state orphanage
p: Akwa Ibom governor Umo Eno attended the traditional wedding of a young woman abandoned at birth and raised in a state-run children's home, standing in as her father and gifting the couple a car and ₦5 million.
body: Akwa Ibom State governor Umo Eno has drawn praise after standing in as father of the bride at the wedding of a young woman raised in a state-owned children's home.

At the traditional marriage and reception held at Ibom Hall in Uyo, reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026, the governor presented the couple with a new car and ₦5 million. The bride was abandoned at birth and grew up in the state government's Special Children's Home in Uyo. She was given automatic employment in the state civil service by the governor in December 2025.

Eno said it was a moment of great joy because the bride, who grew up without a home, had now been given one, and said he hoped her story would inspire others that everyone has a destiny regardless of the circumstances of their birth. He thanked the groom, urged him to love and protect his wife, and warned against domestic violence.
more: Eno stood in as father of the bride.
The couple received a car and ₦5m.
The bride grew up in a state children's home.
